GINA L. SHEETS

SEEKING A TEAM: | AM LOOKING TO APPLY MY SKILL SETS AS A PART OF TEAM WHO MAKES A POSITIVE IMPACT

BUSINESS EXPERIENCE
Senior Fellow with the Sagamore Institution Current
Research and development of agriculture economic policy and practices
Since December 2013, document, analyze and craft policy and best practices for development in Africa, with a focus on agriculture.
Build collaboration, partnerships and networks between Liberia, Africa, China, and Indiana, USA

Vice President of Administration, volunteer, Liberia International Christian College (LICC) Current
Administer policy, manage human resources, and oversee fiscal operations for the college; teach agriculture classes, advise student
government, developed associates degreed agriculture program, demonstration farm
Since January of 2014, created the Department of Agriculture, the applied sciences of agriculture curriculum and a demonstration farm on the
LICC campus, extended agriculture education around Liberia in the most illiterate communities. For three years there was no on sight President
on campus, thus managed all operations and academic strategies of the college. Oversee daily operations of LICC, including financial, human
resources, policy development and academic standards.
Put into place row crop, fruit and vegetable production and animal husbandry production and marketing plans

Co-founder of Hope In The Harvest Missions International Current
Volunteer, serving with husband in the Agriculture Research Center built by the mission along with raising over $700,000 invested in
agriculture development
Since July of 2012 created the USA based NGO of Hope in the Harvest Missions Int. to build economic opportunities in Liberia
Lived full time in Liberia from 2013 to 2017, June.
Created the Agriculture Research Center (ARC) on the LICC campus, the only agriculture research center in Liberia that focuses on soil, crop, and
animal diagnostics,
Developed, train, and impact a staff of 19 full time and up to 67-day labor team members
Host international visitors on short term and long term stays
Work with local/international NGO’s, government officials, and locals on small business and agriculture development

Coordinator Development Liberia, Farmer to Farmer, ACDI VOCA March 2016
Worked with local women’s group and developed plan for local capacity necessary to increase food production and rural incomes, expand
economic growth, and address environmental and natural resource management challenges.
Trained a group of 15 persons (12 women and three men) on business plan development
Worked with the organization to finalize a business management structure with reporting lines applicable to their activities
Created a development plan called Project Refresh for entry into the global pineapple market.
Conducted a review of the organization’s existing management and business structure and make recommendations
Prepared final report on the assignment and training and submitted to in country offices

Director, of the Indiana State Department of Agriculture January 2012-2013
Appointed by the Governor of Indiana, Mike Pence.
Responsible for a multimillion-dollar department oversaw a staff of 65 across the State of Indiana
Indiana is a global leader in the fuel, feed, fiber and fuel industries
Agriculture is the fourth largest GDP sector to Indiana’s economy and over 20% of the workforce
Worked with many global agribusinesses for development and growth opportunities
Resigned from this position to move to Liberia Africa

Director of Economic Development for Indiana State Department of Agriculture July 2009-2012
Agriculture Economic Development
Managed agriculture initiatives for Indiana
In three years there was a creation of committed 3,000 jobs and $3billion of committed investment
In three years Indiana’s production agriculture NVA grew 43%
Managed staff of ten
Managed over $1million in grants and managed a $2million plus budget
Worked on international development projects in multiple countries
Was promoted from this position to the Director’s position by appointment of newly elected Governor Mike Pence.
